title: Activation Pulse: Quarterly OKR Handoff for Private/VPC/On‑Prem
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Establish a repeatable weekly 'Activation Pulse' cadence for the quarterly roadmap that operationalizes OKR handoffs for Private/VPC/On‑Prem deliveries. This ticket defines the playbook, acceptance gates, and the communication rhythm used to move cohorts from staging -> dark launch -> GA.

Why this exists: Previous quarter rollouts exposed gaps between roadmap milestones (PM), infra readiness (ENG), and compliance signoffs (Security/Legal) which led to churn and missed SLAs. The Activation Pulse ties product milestones to concrete safety checks and stakeholder signoffs so we can reliably ship private deployments with predictable activation windows.

Scope: Playbook and runbook for Q2 tranches (up to 12 tenants) covering: readiness checklist, compliance gating, rollback criteria, tranche sizing guidance, and a lightweight dashboard of pulse health signals. Excludes code-level implementation of autoscaling or kernel changes; this is an operational/playbook deliverable with 1 small console UI change to surface pulse status.
acceptance_criteria: Published Activation Pulse playbook in Confluence with step-by-step runbook
Weekly pulse meeting template (15 min) created and calendar-shared with stakeholders
Pulse dashboard prototype in Console showing: tranche status, last checkpoint time, open blockers
All compliance gating items (KMS/HSM, audit logs, network egress) mapped to owners and verification steps
Canary tranche run executed in staging and post-checklist validator returns green
success_metrics: Time-to-GA per tranche reduced by 30% vs previous quarter
Number of last-minute compliance blockers per tranche <= 1
rollout_plan:
Week 0: Publish playbook, stakeholder alignment, add pulse calendar.
Week 1: Run staging canary (1 tenant), collect compliance signoffs, iterate checklist.
Week 2: Execute dark-launch tranche (3 tenants) with full observability and rollback drills.
Week 3: Expand to tranche (6 tenants) if signal stable, schedule GA window.
Contingency: If any compliance gate fails, tranche is halted and a post-mortem is opened within 48 hours.
